svg.title: linear-gla
svg.desc: GLA multiplies the state by Diag(α_t): each key channel (column) fades at its own data-dependent rate, toy α = 1.0, 0.95, 0.5, 0.9, 0.1, 0.99. A scalar decay (Mamba-2, mLSTM) fades every column by the same 0.8. The 1/16 temperature maps sigmoid outputs 0.01, 0.1, 0.5 and 0.9 to α = 0.75, 0.866, 0.958 and 0.993. Bottom right: what one decay value covers in each design.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: St = St-1 Diag(αt ) + vt kt ⊤ , αt = σ(Wα xt + b)1/16 ∈ (0,1)dk
